description: Whisper (STT, GPU with auto-unload) + Kokoro (TTS, CPU) as a reusable voice service pair.
fullDescription:
Voice provides two OpenAI-compatible microservices used by AnythingLLM and other chat apps:

- Whisper (STT) — Speaches (faster-whisper). Runs on GPU with dynamic model loading. Automatically unloads the model after a period of inactivity (default 5 minutes), returning VRAM to the shared pool. First transcription after idle takes ~10s to warm up; subsequent requests are fast.
- Kokoro (TTS) — natural-sounding text-to-speech via the Kokoro FastAPI wrapper. Runs on CPU.

Both services are exposed at OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoints so any chat app pointing at them "just works".

No UI. Install AnythingLLM (AI Stack chart) and point its Whisper/TTS providers here to use them.
